about_the_game:
Gaining technology points by playing Minesweeper

Open grid requires a certain amount of population. Open grid can gain a certain amount of technology value and population. When the technology value reaches the upper limit, the technology level can be increased and the population can be restored.

After the grid is opened, the population required for all the surrounding unopened grid will be displayed. Players need to guess how many people are needed for the next grid  based on this prompt. When the population is insufficient, the game fails.

Difficulties and surprises

When open the grid, you will encounter threats of war and viruses. If you solve these threats in time, you can gain a lot of technology value and reduce the difficulty of the game. You will also encounter additional events and get special rewards.

Game Target

When the technological level reaches a certain level, the population will also increase. At this time, you can consume the population, defeat the aliens, and complete the game.

name: Civilization But Mine

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-3230M CPU @ 2.60GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: 《CIVILIZATION BUT MINE》is a strategy game based on minesweeper. players can open grid to obtain technological value, increase their technological level and population limit, open more grid with more population, and ultimately defeat aliens.
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
